title: Big Pink 1 Bedroom Lockoff Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Big Pink One is a large one-bedroom lock-off home with amazing porches, a king primary, and a tower; all a 4-minute walk to the beach and downtown Seaside! A prime Seaside location home, available off-season only.
description_expanded: Description142 EAST RUSKIN STREETKing - Sleeps 2Prime Location in the Heart of Seaside ProperBig Pink 1 is a spacious one-bedroom lock-off cottage ideally located in Seaside Proper, just steps from Seaside Avenue and Ruskin Park. From this unbeatable location, guests are only a four-minute walk to the beach and moments from Central Square, with more than 35 shops, restaurants, and local favorites right outside the front door. With full access to the home, including expansive porches and a private tower, this charming retreat delivers a true Seaside experience.Iconic Outdoor Living & Wrap-Around PorchesOutdoor living is front and center at Big Pink 1. A generous wrap-around open-air porch welcomes guests with bench seating and a classic porch swing—perfect for morning coffee or afternoon relaxation. Around back, a screened-in rear porch offers a peaceful escape with colorful outdoor seating, including a gliding swing, four rockers, and a bistro table, all overlooking a private, lush backyard complete with a gas grill for easy outdoor meals.Bright Living Spaces & Entertaining-Friendly LayoutInside, the home opens to a bright and cheerful living area furnished with two sofas and two club chairs, creating a comfortable space for gathering. A large wall-mounted flat-screen TV makes movie nights or game days easy and enjoyable. The adjacent dining area comfortably seats six to eight guests and flows seamlessly into the well-equipped kitchen, featuring a farmhouse sink, ample counter space, and breakfast bar seating for six. A convenient half bath is located off the main living area for guest use.Private King Suite & Elevated Tower RetreatUpstairs, the king primary suite provides a relaxing retreat with a large mounted flat-screen TV and an updated private bathroom featuring a single vanity and glass-enclosed walk-in shower. Above it all, the third-floor tower is a standout feature—offering treetop and town views, wrap-around bench seating, and a TV. This elevated space is ideal for unwinding, reading, or escaping for a quiet moment away from it all.Thoughtful Amenities for a Relaxing StayA full-size washer and dryer tucked into a laundry closet adds everyday convenience, making longer stays easy and comfortable. With its prime location, iconic porches, and unique tower, Big Pink 1 is a standout Seaside cottage—perfect for couples or guests seeking a walkable, charming home base in Seaside, Florida.* Not available Spring or Summer. 2 night min Fall; 2 night min Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration.Features4-minute walk (352 yards) to beach accessSeaside Private Residential Beach at East Ruskin Pavilion – the largest stretch of private beach on 30AExpansive wrap-around front porch with swingOutdoor showerFull-size washer & dryerPeacock Alley Linens – fresh, luxurious Peacock Alley towels and sheets throughout the homeAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts & 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), plus a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay, with starter amenities provided1 parking pass issued for one-bedroom homes. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permitNo pets allowed
